app.name: xDev
app.tagline: Local-first project knowledge for humans and AI agents.
welcome.hint: Pick a folder of Markdown files. Your files stay where they are; xDev only keeps a search index on this computer.
vault.label: Open folder: {path}
search.label: Search documents
sidebar.title: Documents
sidebar.empty: This folder has no Markdown files yet.
editor.placeholder: Pick a document on the left, or press {shortcut} to search.
editor.label: Document editor
conflict.title: File changed on disk
conflict.body: Another program changed this file while you had unsaved edits.
tabs.label: Sidebar views
changes.title: Pending changes
changes.noGit: Git is not installed, so xDev cannot track changes yet.
changes.noGitHint: Install it from git-scm.com, then come back to this window.
changes.noRepo: This folder is not tracked yet. Start tracking to review every change before it counts.
changes.unsaved: The open document has edits that could not be saved. Resolve them first.
diff.label: Changes in this document
history.title: History
history.empty: No history yet. Approve a change to start one.
history.pick: Pick a version to compare it with the document as it is now.
history.missing: This document did not exist in that version.
history.confirmBody: The document is replaced with the text from “{message}”. The restore then waits in Changes for your approval.
language.label: Language
error.not_found: The file or folder was not found.
error.outside_vault: That path is outside the open folder.
error.io: The file could not be read or written.
error.not_utf8: This file is not UTF-8 text.
error.too_large: This file is larger than 5 MB.
error.no_git: Git is not installed or not on PATH.
error.no_repo: This folder is not tracked with git yet.
error.git_identity: Git does not know who you are yet. Run these two commands in a terminal, then try again:
error.stale: The docs changed after this preview. Check the new preview, then write again.
doc.mode.label: View
doc.agentsList: This doc lists its agents by hand in the frontmatter. Edit the agents line to change them.
preview.title: Title
backlinks.label: Docs linking here
backlinks.title: Linked from ({count})
backlinks.empty: No other doc links here yet.
agents.title: Agent context
agents.empty: No doc is marked for agents yet.
agents.emptyHint: Open a doc and tick “{checkbox}” in its header. Its text then goes into AGENTS.md and the other agent files.
agents.noFiles: No agent file would be written.
agents.foreign: This file was not written by xDev, so it is left as it is. Move or rename it if xDev should write here.
agents.unchanged: This file already matches the docs.
agents.tooLarge: AGENTS.md is larger than 32 KiB. Some agents may stop reading after 32 KiB, so the end could be ignored.
